why_ai: Undifferentiated horizontal SaaS that AI-native agents and suites can replicate and absorb.
why_clarity: Task tracking is defined, but whether work became visible has no agreed measure.
why_digital: Software built and sold online, used entirely on screens.

why_ai: Relevance scoring, batching and routing of notifications are tractable ML tasks.
why_clarity: Interruption load is unmeasured and has no owner defining success.
why_digital: Notification streams in, filtered and batched delivery out.

why_ai: Inferring programme state across tools is federation and inference work AI agents target.
why_clarity: Each cross-functional programme differs and its true state is not directly observable.
why_digital: Data from many work tools in, a programme view out.

why_ai: Dependency information already exists as text and structure for models to extract.
why_clarity: A dependency graph is checkable against what actually blocked delivery.
why_digital: Tool data in, a dependency graph out, all in software.

why_ai: Commits, reviews and deployments leave a complete trail that software reads directly.
why_clarity: Code activity gives an unambiguous, instant record of what happened.
why_digital: Developer stack events in, tracked work out.

why_ai: Access, identity and document exchange are solved problems awaiting better product design.
why_clarity: Outside parties either participate with control preserved or they fall back to email.
why_digital: Documents and messages exchanged online across organisations.

why_ai: Traces are in the tools, but turning them into promotion evidence is a contested management judgment.
why_clarity: What counts as contribution is contested and promotion outcomes arrive slowly.
why_digital: Activity traces in work tools analysed on screens.

why_ai: Recordkeeping rules carry regulatory penalties, though classification and retention are rule-governed automation.
why_clarity: Retention and restriction rules define exactly what must be kept and found.
why_digital: Messages and documents in, retained and restricted records out.

why_ai: A team's real process is inferable from activity, so templates can be generated automatically.
why_clarity: Template retention past the first month is a clear measure, though fit is subjective.
why_digital: Activity data in, templates and onboarding content out.

why_ai: Tasks, boards and dashboards are commodity features AI-native tools reproduce.
why_clarity: Features are defined, but whether a suite works differs by engineering and cross-functional use.
why_digital: Software used and bought entirely online.

why_ai: Status inferred from a complete activity record replaces humans typing updates.
why_clarity: Inferred status is checkable against what the activity record shows.
why_digital: Activity logs in, observed status out.
